spec.description: Read-only Klaviyo email reporting for our SECOND brand (replica run 3). This brand uses a DIFFERENT Klaviyo account than our existing email reporting project, so it authenticates with its OWN API key stored as KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 (a dummy placeholder value for now, to be replaced with the real brand-2 key when available). HARD RULE: never use the default/existing Klaviyo key for this project — all Klaviyo calls for brand 2 must read KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 and nothing else. Scope is strictly READ-ONLY reporting: pull campaign/flow/list performance (sends, opens, clicks, revenue, unsubscribes, etc.) from the brand-2 Klaviyo account and produce reports. No sending, no list edits, no writes of any kind to Klaviyo. All generated reports/artifacts live inside this project's own folder.
features: Connect to the brand-2 Klaviyo account using KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 only (dummy value for now; default key explicitly forbidden)
Read-only pull of campaign performance metrics (sends, deliveries, opens, clicks, revenue, unsubscribes, bounces)
Read-only pull of flow performance metrics
Read-only pull of list/segment growth and engagement
Periodic/on-demand email performance report generated into this project's folder (summary + per-campaign/flow breakdown)
Strict isolation from the existing brand-1 email project: separate key, separate reports, no shared credentials
